sources.title: skylenage-ai/SkyJM-Edit-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SkyJM （RubricRM） is a reward model for visual generation, covering both text-to-image generation and image editing. Given a prompt and two candidate images, it predicts which one better satisfies the instruction.

sources.title: SkyJM - Learn AI
sources.snippet: The model family includes four primary variants for visual tasks, SkyJM-Gen-4B and SkyJM-Gen-9B for evaluating text-to-image generation, and SkyJM-Edit-4B and SkyJM-Edit-9B for assessing instruction-based image editing, as well as SkyJM-TTS for evaluating text-to-speech audio quality.
